selected_design_row_pins.literal_reference: | C02 | Semantic input/result v1 and profile revisions | Strict bounded decoding, exact numbers/timestamps/owner dates, native SDK aggregate retention, selection/units/reducers/BMI, ordered batches, cancellation, rollup revision admission. |

### K02: deterministic semantic engine

Port the semantic session as a bounded state machine rather than a convenience reducer over unbounded arrays. Preserve explicit owner dates, epoch-seconds/nanoseconds ordering, source ordinals, stable record identity across rechunking, profile selection, direct/dependency attribution, unit normalization, reducer dispatch, BMI dependency retention, paired blood-pressure selection, workout duration weights, platform extension retention, empty captured dates, and Apple period/range roll-ups. Native acquisition still supplies SDK aggregation, deduplication, calendar offset resolution, permissions, and provider evidence. Sources: [semantic implementation](../../packages/healthmd-core-rust/crates/healthmd-core/src/semantic.rs) and [semantic-input normative contract](../../packages/contracts/semantic-input/v1/contract.md).

The input/output representation retains finite binary64 bits including negative zero, canonical signed/unsigned decimal integers beyond JavaScript's safe range, and exact time tuples. Decode binary64 explicitly for reviewed arithmetic with the original reduction order; retain integer strings/`bigint` and seconds/nanoseconds rather than rounding them through `number` or `Date`. Exact rendering remains its own codec. Preserve configured bounds and transactional batch advancement. Cancellation is idempotent, checked before parsing, every 64 records, and before reduction; observed cancellation clears retained records and returns a terminal cancelled result with no days. Effect interruption must connect to this state transition, with bounded JS yields to let interruption be observed.

Exit evidence: the shared semantic differential fixture and profile-revision fixture pass without fixture edits; invalid batches do not advance indexes; rechunking preserves identity/output; sequential ordering, empty-day coverage, missing/zero, dependencies, cancellation, session bounds, and terminal calls match current behavior. Compare outputs with current Rust and relevant Swift/Kotlin reference paths while both implementations remain available.
| F05 | Exact binary64/integer/time/Unicode/serializer behavior | M03 passes frozen positive/negative vectors in every deployed engine; resolve codecs rather than changing historical files. |

candidate_interfaces.result: CODEC-SEMANTIC-RESULT owns immutable exact SemanticResult structural model and strict decoded result validation. candidate_interfaces.admission: SEMANTIC-RECORD-ADMISSION owns configuration/profile evidence and immutable validated/retain-or-filter decisions. Build reviewed semantic Raw-view index from exact canonical asset, distinct from strict RegistryDocument parser, with explicit reviewed static host byte binding. Native SDK grants/capture/aggregation/source deduplication remain supplied upstream.
candidate_interfaces.session: SEMANTIC-BATCH-TRANSACTION owns one private session with immutable/copy-on-write staged deltas; ordered cancellation checkpoints and a reviewed pure final-reduction port declared here. Port consumes only owned immutable retained records/owner dates and returns typed daily/rollup/extensions or safe failure. Initial completion is tested only with a fixture fake port; SEMANTIC-SCALAR-GROUP does not constitute the full daily/BMI/rollup engine.
candidate_interfaces.cancel: SEMANTIC-SESSION-CANCEL owns Effect orchestration over the accepted session/checkpoint contract. Mask only atomic ownership/finalizer registration and terminal publication; actual decoding/iteration/reduction interruptible with bounded yields. Completion of cancellation waits cleanup/port acknowledgment. No Fiber identity/raw Cause/parser/value in safe errors.
candidate_interfaces.scalar: SEMANTIC-SCALAR-GROUP owns ordered one-day/one-output numeric group result only, not daily/session/result serialization integration. No reconstruction of sdk_aggregate facts; duplicate/mixed SDK facts reject.
candidate_interfaces.boundary_preconditions: Trusted upstream static registry-byte binding and reviewed native IANA-timezone evidence are explicit candidate preconditions until separate resolver/source host admission. Config syntax validation does not prove chrono_tz::Tz membership; first session fixture uses independently reviewed exact timezone evidence. No native permission/source/timezone authority inferred from strings.
candidate_interfaces.parser_scope: Strict config/batch/record/value/timestamp/unit/extension structs and enum tags; defaults/nullable Option behavior mirror serde. Exact string representations use accepted CODEC-VALUES. Detect duplicate decoded known keys, malformed UTF-8/unpaired surrogate and relevant u32/i32/u64 primitive token grammar before lossy JSON.parse; full general JSON numeric lexeme/canonical serializer behavior remains separate.
candidate_interfaces.record_meter_scope: Independent record-only byte measurement must match serde_json::to_vec(SemanticRecord) including field order, null Options, default attributes/extensions, UTF-8, escapes and lexical u32/i32 fields. It is mandatory before session 65536-byte qualification, and does not qualify a whole canonical result/export serializer.
candidate_interfaces.deferred_operations: Each unsupported candidate integration operation uses a distinct private candidate_not_implemented status. Never relabel a currently supported native profile/reducer/rollup unavailable, silently emit incomplete completed results, or change public CoreError semantics.
